proved as stated The exact Hopf pole graph has r elliptic roots and v rational vertices after k blowups, so equality forces k=v and zero conductor-image Euler number. In the all-elliptic image case every rational pole contracts and no elliptic root does. The resolution-to-minimal-model and resolution-to-normalization maps then have exactly the same connected fibres; normalizing their graph image gives proper finite birational projections to normal surfaces, hence a holomorphic isomorphism of the normalization with the minimal Hopf surface. In the sole remaining graph count, the homomorphism from the Hopf group to Z has finite kernel and each elliptic-root map has infinite image by the actual universal-cover lift argument. Quotienting each elliptic vertex by the saturated image of its rank-one kernel gives a surjection to a graph of cyclic groups. Removing its unique trivial-edge cycle leaves a tree amalgam containing Z; restoring it yields a free product with Z containing F2, contradicting virtual abelianness. Thus the equality normalization is smooth minimal Hopf. Source proof and historical review records were available; this is a re-derivation, not a blind check.

On the actual point-blown-up ruled model, every vertical component E has negative self-intersection by the full multiplicity equation m_E E²+sum m_j(E_j E)=0. If E lies outside D, then DE=2+E²≥0, so E² is−1 or−2. The latter gives DE=0 and is disjoint from D; the resolution is an isomorphism there by R6. Removing the fibre multiplicity is unramified on E, and its finite etale pullback consists of P1s. Actual smooth-family transport places its normal square−2 sphere in a nearby T4, impossible. Thus E²=−1 and DE=1, giving one transverse intersection with a coefficient-one pole component. Two outside components cannot be adjacent: the positive full-fibre multiplicity relations would give both m_E>m_Eprime and m_Eprime>m_E. Therefore all such components are pairwise disjoint leaves. No multiplicity-one assumption was used. New derivation after reading the supplied proof; not a blind review and not an independent human check.
